request.subject: ICON:ACTION:ASSEMBLE

layers.text: Redraw it as a different object in the same style: one big bright copper wind-up key, a short shaft with a flat round handle with two round holes, lying across one soot-black iron cog wheel with square teeth. Nothing else: no rotor, no bomb, no face. Thick black outline, flat colours, on a transparent background.
